comment: Generated by Tools/pose-data.mjs from the web at core2.webSha (src/content/poseSprites.js, src/ui/services/PoseAnimator.js, content/config/ui/presentation/poseAnimator.json). Do not edit. The player figure is a pose stage (the web style "animated"): a canvas of canvas.width x canvas.height holds every frame of a class and tint at its own crop (x, y, w, h); the stage seats the idle frame's floor line g on the bottom of the figure box and its pelvis rx on the box centre. frames["<class>_<pose>_<tint>"] = [x, y, w, h, rx, ry, g].
